method.visualEvidence: Inspected every quality.json exterior view, every declared room view, every declared deck view, and exploded 0/50/100 evidence for all 20 IDs. Duplicate full-review/qa renders were treated as supporting evidence, not separate approvals.
readOnlyChecks: Current Blender master existence and SHA-256 alignment
Manifest v2 identity, asset bytes and SHA-256 alignment
Technical-review asset declarations against parsed GLB JSON
Room/deck/exploded evidence path and screenshot SHA-256 coverage

collectionBlockers.subject: Reference-faithful silhouette and distinctive geometry are not demonstrated
collectionBlockers.evidence: All 459 manifest components are declared shape=box. The inspected exterior frames show repeated slab/box hulls, generic rooflines, glazing blocks and deck furniture across the fleet; the Princess and most Sunseeker variants are visibly interchangeable at review scale.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Rebuild the hull, superstructure, glazing, deck arrangement and model-specific signature features from reference evidence, then rerender all exterior angles.

collectionBlockers.subject: Rooms are blockout evidence, not release-quality furnished interiors
collectionBlockers.evidence: All 111 declared rooms have screenshot coverage, but the inspected views are mostly isolated slabs, walls, beds, benches and cylinders on open boards. Engine-room views are commonly empty or minimally furnished; room boundaries, joinery, doors, fixtures and support relationships are not resolved.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Author complete, contained room assemblies with physically supported fittings, model-specific layouts, joinery, fixtures and credible machinery spaces.

collectionBlockers.subject: Material and texture fidelity fails
collectionBlockers.evidence: All 84 parsed GLBs contain zero textures and zero images. The renders rely on a small set of flat procedural colors and simple highlight response; the draft textures and materials-in-all-views checks fail for all 20 yachts.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Replace placeholder material treatment with reference-supported hull, glazing, upholstery, wood, metal and machinery materials, including texture/image payloads where required.

collectionBlockers.subject: Review camera and lighting evidence is not reliable
collectionBlockers.evidence: The below-hull frame is underlit or near-black for all 20 yachts, preventing inspection of hull closure, normals and underwater details. Predator 57 and Manhattan 63 also show room cameras aimed into the exterior hull rather than usable interior views.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Fix camera targets, clipping distances, room framing and below-hull lighting; rerender and independently recheck every required view.

collectionBlockers.subject: LOD exports are not optimized
collectionBlockers.evidence: All 21 interior LOD pairs are byte-identical. Of 20 exterior pairs, 19 have more triangles in LOD1 than LOD0 and one has the same count; no exterior LOD1 is lighter by triangle count.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Produce genuinely decreasing LODs with verified bytes, triangle counts and visual parity at the intended distances.

collectionBlockers.subject: Review metadata is incomplete or contradictory
collectionBlockers.evidence: Nineteen metrics.json files report renderedViews=[] despite render evidence being present; Superhawk 55 has no metrics.json. Its scene_report.json still says assets=[] and renderOutputs=[] while the current manifest and technical-review.json list six verified assets.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Regenerate review metadata from the current master/export and require one coherent evidence record per release candidate.

collectionBlockers.subject: No model has independent approval
collectionBlockers.evidence: All 20 quality.json files are explicitly status=changes-required with reviewer=independent-qa-pending. All 20 technical-review.json files report visualReview=pending and publicationReady=false.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Do not publish or promote the collection until each selected ID passes a fresh independent visual review and all blockers are closed.

doNotPromoteUntil: All 20 models receive another reference-faithful geometry pass.
Room and deck assemblies are contained, furnished and physically supported.
Materials/textures are authored and visible in every required view.
Cameras and below-hull lighting are corrected, including Predator 57 and Manhattan 63 room clipping.
LOD exports are genuinely optimized and metadata is regenerated from current files.
Every selected model receives independent approval with no failing quality checks.
